svg.title: Wall-time performance profile for jointly optimal B&B instances
svg.desc: Performance profile over 365 instances solved optimally by all seven methods. Each ratio is (method wall time plus 1-second shift) divided by (fastest wall time plus the same shift). The vertical axis is the fraction of instances completed within that factor. Color identifies the search method, while line style identifies the LP configuration.
svg.text: Performance profile on 365 jointly optimal J30 instances with a 1-second shift
Shifted wall-time factor relative to fastest method (1-second shift; log scale)
